review_description: The sales quoting was thorough and hassle free.Customer service was OK.Organisation of grid connection was done .Overall great job!!
The  salesperson was exemplary with all our queries and offered alternative suggestions to our requirements.

NG Elec came to the house, reviewed what we had and went through with us what we required.Their team arrived within a week and installed 30 solar pannels on a very steep 2nd story roof, and then came back on the 1st July and installed the batteries.13.2kwh solar pannels16..2kwh batteryNG fined tuned the system over 2 days and we can now run 24hrs on solar and battery as long as we get sunlight for at least 4 hours a day.

5-Star Review for NG Solar and Electrical InstallationWe sought out three quotes and ultimately chose NG Elec based on their technical proposal and Nathan’s exceptional ability to explain a complex subject in a way that made sense to the non-technical person in our household—this was a standout factor for us. Price was also a consideration, and their clear communication and professionalism sealed the deal.From accepting the quote to installation day, NG Elec kept us well-informed at every step, demonstrating a well-organised and efficient operation.On installation day, the team arrived on time, assessed the job, and got straight to work. It was clear they knew exactly what they were doing, and their camaraderie showed they worked seamlessly together. By 2:00 PM, our system was up and running, with no mess left behind.Nathan took the time to walk us through the phone apps for monitoring the system, explaining everything in a way that was easy to understand.Nathan, your team is a credit to you, and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend NG Elec to anyone. If we could give a 6-star rating, we absolutely would! ??????And please pass out thanks and appreciation on to your team.

NG Elec provided excellent information during the quoting process so, while they weren't the cheapest option, I was confident of getting a better product in the end.Very friendly, clear information on what was being provided and excellent service during the installation.

We found the supplier took time to explain the proposal and potential alternatives. He answered all our questions and the install was organised and implemented in a very efficient, professional and safe manner.

Nathan contacted me quickly after I requested three installer recommendations from Solar Quotes.I wanted to double the size of my existing solar plant and required monitoring of the entire system including the existing non-monitored plant.He visited the site the next day and spent the time to listen to my ideas of what I wanted to achieve and the componentry I wanted as a minimum quality. He provided a quote that evening and after some discussion on pricing he got my business due to his knowledge of what he was doing, and his professional assistance.NG Elec did all the paperwork and approvals quickly, turned up on the allocated day and the team were efficient and polite from start to finish.They struck a small glitch with the monitoring due to an incorrectly supplied part but diagnosed it with the help of Sungrow support and fixed in a couple of days.I would highly recommend Nathan and his team to anyone.

Right from the outset Nathan responded to our request for a quote with promptness and professionalism. He provided a clear concise information and reports on quality components being used. When the installers came on time, they were polite and well organised installing the unit within a day as promised. Nathan concluded the install by walking us through the system and the Consumption App. Very happy with the result and have no hesitation in recommending Nathan and his team.
